final: WITH d AS (SELECT c.district_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM client c GROUP BY c.district_id), t AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM client) SELECT di.A3 AS region, AVG(d.n * 1.0) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(d.n * 1.0 / t.total) AS avg_share FROM d JOIN district di ON di.district_id = d.district_id CROSS JOIN t GROUP BY di.A3
